criteria.description: Selects a sales motion that fits the product economics (high ACV, long implementation, multi-stakeholder → enterprise/field sales) and explicitly flags the proposed freemium/self-serve/TikTok approach as a mismatch.
Recommends channels that fit the enterprise motion (ABM, outbound, partnerships, events, analyst relations) rather than the contradictory viral/TikTok channels.
Defines the ICP and recognizes the multi-stakeholder buying group (compliance, IT, legal, procurement), not a single self-serve user.
Sanity-checks CAC vs. the $120k ACV / sales-cycle economics rather than ignoring acquisition cost.
Anchors on a core message/positioning and a GTM metric/first milestone appropriate to the motion.
